<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>stage-code-review-findings</code></p>

Stage evidence-backed review findings in chat until the user selects exactly what may become an external draft.

## When to use

Hold evidence-backed code-review findings in chat until the user selects what may become an external draft. Use for local, draft, or pre-publication review.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link stage-code-review-findings --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link stage-code-review-findings --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Examples

### Review without publishing

**Prompt**

> Use the stage-code-review-findings skill to review my uncommitted changes. Keep every finding in Polish and in chat only.

**Expected outcome**

Actionable findings with stable IDs, tight line anchors, and no source edits, browser drafts, or provider mutations.

### Publish selected findings only

**Prompt**

> Accept F1 and F3 from the staged review and prepare them for the named pull request. Leave every other finding unpublished.

**Expected outcome**

Only the accepted findings advance in concise reviewer-facing English after their anchors are revalidated.
